Aisha: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone pulse for runtime-v3 rollout. Who owns the remaining items? Please state shipped / slipped / next steps. Ping owners: @Ben @Yvonne @Manu @Diego :eyes:

Ben: Shipped: canary autoscale fix (deployed to canary), perf regression hotfix for prompt caching. Slipped: multi-node KV cache tuning — discovered serialization bug, blocked by infra change. ETA: aiming EOD Thu if Yvonne can take perf tuning.

Yvonne: I can take perf tuning. Will pair with Ben tomorrow AM. ETA EOD Thu. :thumbsup: 

Manu: Infra note: scheduled full rollout deploy Wed 03:00 UTC but need the new cert from eng-security (ticket SE-112). If cert delayed, we'll push to Fri.

Claire: Product asks: we need rollback plan and customer-facing note draft if rollout slides. @Aisha can you own the draft?

Aisha: Yep, I'll draft the note by EOD today and post here for review.

Diego: CR update: PR #2345 (kv-serialization-fix) -> LGTM, left one nit. Tests passing on CI. Will merge once nit's addressed.

Ben: Added owners list + status:
```
- kv-serialization-fix: owner Diego -> PR #2345 (pending merge)
- multi-node-tuning: owner Yvonne -> in progress (ETA EOD Thu)
- cert (SE-112): owner Manu -> waiting on eng-security
- rollback plan: owner Aisha -> draft due today
- canary metrics: owner Ben -> green
```

Yvonne: Quick ask — need access to perf logs (prod-staging). @Manu can you grant? :pray:

Manu: Granted to Yvonne and Ben — check `perf-team` group.

Ben: One more: code review pings for related PRs: @Claire please add priority to PR review board if docs needed.

Claire: Will do. Also flagging dependent infra change: autoscaler config rename -> requires async update in Dedicated config repo.

Ben: Noted. If cert arrives and PR merges, we'll aim for canary -> small % -> 24h watch -> gradual.

Aisha: Thanks all. I'll compile a short status update for execs once Diego merges PR and Yvonne confirms tuning done. :rocket:
